stories.title: ThreatsDay: 10M NGINX Services at Risk, 250+ Malicious Extensions, AI Server Hijacking + 17 More Stories
stories.description: This week's ThreatsDay tracks hidden browser threats, critical NGINX flaws, credential theft, ransomware trends, and major cybercrime busts.

stories.title: FIFA Says It Has Been Victim of a Cyberattack Accessing ‘Personal and Business Information’
stories.description: FIFA didn’t say when the cyberattack took place, or the precise nature of the hacked information.

stories.title: Moving Beyond Static Cookie Banners: Implementing Zero-Leakage Real-Time Consent Management
stories.description: Static cookie banners leak user data before consent. Learn how to implement real-time consent management with script blocking, GPC, and Consent Mode v2.

stories.title: North Korea-Linked PolinRider Poisons Over 7,600 GitHub Repositories to Spread Malware
stories.description: SafeDep found a PolinRider Python loader in 375 GitHub repositories that uses Ethereum transactions to retrieve and execute JavaScript.

stories.title: Hackers Hide Password-Stealing Malware in GitHub Code, Putting Software Downloads at Risk
stories.description: Hackers used malicious GitHub pull requests to inject password-stealing malware into AsyncAPI, CircuitVerse and Open Food Facts projects.

stories.title: Bithumb Hacked for 15 Days, Customer Passport Numbers, Bank Details and Wallet Addresses Stolen
stories.description: Bithumb says hackers stole passport, bank account, and crypto wallet details after accessing its internal system for over 15 days.

stories.title: CISA Adds 10 Flaws from Danfoss, HPE, Mitel MiCollab and Vates Xen to Exploited Catalog
stories.description: CISA added 10 actively exploited flaws to its KEV Catalog, affecting Mitel, Danfoss, HPE Juniper, and Vates products.

stories.title: Critical Juniper Session Smart Conductor Flaw Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: Tracked as CVE-2026-103406, the vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root.

stories.title: Mitel MiCollab Zero-Days Exploited in Suspected AI-Assisted Attacks
stories.description: Accenture says hackers exploited MiCollab flaws before Mitel’s advisory, likely aided by AI, in a suspected extortion campaign.

stories.title: Most Wanted: The Phishing Kits and Techniques Getting Past Security Controls
stories.description: Push Security reports DOMDIFFER led phishing kit breakthrough rates from August to October 2026, targeting corporate Google and Microsoft accounts.

stories.title: 1Password Hacked, Customer Data and Source Code Stolen in GitHub Account Breach
stories.description: 1Password says an attacker stole customer account data and source code via a compromised employee GitHub account, but vaults were unaffected.

stories.title: Drupal Installer Patch Left a Gap Attackers Are Already Exploiting
stories.description: Drupal warns that its previous installer patch left some websites vulnerable to takeover, with attackers already exploiting the gap.
